name: Supabase
description: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres database, Auth (GoTrue), PostgREST auto-API, Realtime, the Studio admin dashboard, and a built-in gateway that exposes the familiar /auth/v1, /rest/v1, /graphql/v1, /realtime/v1, and /pg/ paths on one URL. Excludes Storage, the connection pooler, and Edge Functions to fit the memory ceiling. The gateway deployment is the public entry point -- flip it public from its Access control tab once everything is up, then open Studio at / to finish setup. Your anon key, service-role key, and database password are shown once at install.
